Why patience wins

Every careful reader eventually notices that the strongest arguments are rarely the loudest ones, and that patience tends to beat cleverness over any long enough stretch of time. The details matter here because small decisions compound, and a team that keeps making slightly better choices will end up somewhere its competitors cannot easily follow.
